correctness.rationale: Binary synchronous four-neighbor update on Z/m x Z/n, m=2^a>=4,n>=3, is multiplication by u+u^-1+v+v^-1 in GF(2) group algebra. CRT splits v=1 primary dim d=2^{v2(n)} and invertible nontrivial v components of dimension n-d. The horizontal u+u^-1 is nilpotent, hence sum with invertible v+v^-1 is invertible off v=1. On both local components write u+u^-1=w²/u; tensor sum of size A,B power-two Jordan blocks is min(A,B) blocks of max(A,B), by Frobenius change s+t=z and truncated module freeness. Thus nilpotent type c=2min(m,d) blocks length ell=max(m,d)/2, including d=1 edge case. Fitting split gives exact first-periodic-entry counts, cumulative distribution and E[T]. Independent GF(2) matrices for five tori confirmed all predicted ranks; not used as infinite proof.
